name: Verify chat panel is usable on mobile viewport
objective: Validate chat panel fills screen properly on mobile
precondition: User logged in on mobile viewport, chat open

steps.description: Set the browser viewport to mobile dimensions
steps.expectedResult: Viewport is set to mobile size

steps.description: Open the chat panel by clicking the Agentforce icon
Verify the chat panel fills the screen properly on mobile
steps.expectedResult: Chat panel is displayed at appropriate size for mobile, filling the available screen space

steps.description: Verify the input field is visible and usable
steps.expectedResult: Chat input field is visible and accessible for typing
